headline: LION COPPER NAILS 6.71B LBS CU INDICATED AT BEAR — Nevada's New Giant; 1,064 Mt @ 0.29% Cu In Rio Tinto-Backed Yerington District (CSE: LEO)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Lion Copper and Gold Corp.
snippet: Lion Copper and Gold Corp. (CSE: LEO) announced August 4, 2026 its maiden Mineral Resource Estimate for the Bear Deposit at the Yerington Copper Project in Lyon County, Nevada: an Indicated Resource of 6.71 billion pounds of contained copper (1,064 Mt at 0.29% Cu) and an Inferred Resource of 8.77 billion pounds of contained copper (1,770 Mt at 0.22% Cu), using a 0.10% Cu break-even cut-off grade. The Bear deposit sits within the larger Rio Tinto-backed Yerington copper district and is now described as one of Nevada's largest undeveloped red metal resources — a significant technical milestone that provides the engineering platform for mine planning, resource conversion, and future feasibility work. At copper above $6.40/lb and JP Morgan projecting a 330,000-tonne refined deficit in 2026, a maiden 6.71-billion-pound indicated resource in a permitted US mining district with Rio Tinto infrastructure backing represents exactly the category of domestic critical mineral asset where institutional capital and strategic acquirer attention is converging.

headline: SOUTHERN CROSS GOLD DOUBLES EXPLORATION TARGET TO 3.0-4.6 MOZ AT 8.9-12.1 g/t AuEq — Nine Rigs Turning At Gold-Antimony System On 11km Corridor (TSX: SXGC | ASX: SX2)
source_name: Newsfile Corp / Southern Cross Gold Consolidated Ltd.
snippet: Southern Cross Gold Consolidated (TSX: SXGC | ASX: SX2) announced August 4, 2026 an updated Exploration Target for the Sunday Creek Gold-Antimony Project in Victoria, Australia: 3.0 to 4.6 million ounces gold equivalent at 8.9 to 12.1 g/t AuEq across 10.4 to 11.9 million tonnes — roughly double the prior target — as five prospects now anchor a 1,500-metre mineralised footprint grown from the original 1,020-metre strike, with nine rigs currently turning on-site and two additional rigs testing regional targets up to 8 km away. The updated target covers only 1.5 km of an 11-km mineralised corridor, leaving substantial room for further expansion; recent drilling returned a 481-metre mineralised zone linking the Christina and Golden Dyke prospects, including 0.8 metres at 141 g/t gold with individual assays to 496 g/t. For TSX-V and ASX junior gold investors, Sunday Creek's combination of high-grade gold, antimony co-product (a US-designated critical mineral now subject to Chinese export controls), S&P/TSX Composite membership, and nine-rig drilling intensity at 1,500-metre scale represents one of the highest-conviction exploration programs active in 2026.

headline: FIREFLY METALS 11.5m AT 13.2% CuEq IN GREEN BAY HIGH-GRADE CORE — PEA Due This Month; 197,714m Drilled Into VMS System With MRE Update Imminent (ASX/TSX: FFM)
snippet: FireFly Metals Ltd. (ASX/TSX: FFM) released August 3, 2026 another batch of exceptional underground drill assays from the Green Bay Copper-Gold Project in Newfoundland and Labrador, Canada — with results including 11.5 metres at 13.2% copper equivalent, confirming the continuity and grade intensity of the Core Zone that will anchor an imminent upscaled Preliminary Economic Assessment expected by end of August 2026. Cumulative underground diamond drilling since FireFly's October 2023 acquisition has reached 197,714 metres across 42 completed holes in the current batch, and the Core Zone now holds 8.8 million tonnes at 3.9% CuEq Measured and Indicated plus 10.9 million tonnes at 3.8% CuEq Inferred — resource geometry that supports a high-margin, early production restart scenario at a copper price above $6.40/lb. With approximately A$196 million in cash and a bankable feasibility study targeted for late 2026 or early 2027, FireFly has the balance sheet and drilling momentum to convert Green Bay from a world-class drill story into a copper-gold producer on an accelerated timeline.

headline: GUANAJUATO SILVER GETS MEXICO PERMITS — 45 Drill Pads On 3.7km Historical Silver Trend At El Horcon Jalisco; 5,000m Phase 1 Now Authorized (TSX-V: GSVR)
snippet: Guanajuato Silver Company Ltd. (TSX-V: GSVR) announced August 4, 2026 the receipt of formal approval from Mexican government agencies to commence a surface drilling program at its El Horcon project in Jalisco, Mexico, approximately 60 km northwest of the city of Guanajuato. The permits authorize up to 45 drill pads along a 3.7-kilometre trend covering approximately one-third of the total structural prospectivity on the Horcon property, with 5,000 metres of Phase 1 surface drilling planned at an average depth of approximately 260 metres per hole plus one deeper test to 500 metres, targeting both lateral expansion and depth extension of a historical silver resource within multiple en echelon veins. For TSX-V silver investors, the Jalisco permit approval converts years of surface evaluation into drillable hypothesis at a moment when silver above $58/oz has restored economics to high-grade Mexican silver veins that were marginal at prior price levels.

headline: DE-DOLLARIZATION ALERT: China Launches mBridge Cross-Border Network — CIPS Processed $245T In 2025, Up 43%; Dollar-Settled Trade Routes Structurally Bypassed
snippet: Money Metals Exchange published August 3, 2026 analysis on China's imminent activation of the mBridge cross-border payment platform — a multi-central-bank digital currency network backed by the People's Bank of China, Hong Kong, Thailand, and the UAE that allows international settlement in national currencies without touching the US dollar-denominated SWIFT correspondent banking system. China's Cross-Border Interbank Payment System (CIPS) processed yuan-denominated transactions equivalent to $245 trillion during 2025, a 43% year-on-year increase — a rate of growth that, if sustained, would make dollar exclusion from a significant share of global trade commerce a 2026-2027 structural reality rather than a theoretical scenario. For gold investors, de-dollarization has been the long-run structural driver behind central bank gold accumulation — countries holding BRICS-aligned payment infrastructure have a strong incentive to hold gold rather than US Treasuries as a reserve asset, reinforcing the WGC's recent data showing record central bank gold buying of 289 tonnes in Q2 2026 despite a 16% price decline.

headline: FRANK HOLMES: GOLD BULL 'FAR FROM OVER' — $350T Global Debt + Asian Love Trade + BRICS Central Banks Build Structural Floor Under $4,000
snippet: U.S. Global Investors CEO Frank Holmes, published August 3, 2026 on Money Metals Exchange, argues the gold bull market remains structurally intact despite the 24% drawdown from January's $5,598 record — citing two durable demand pillars that short-term Fed and war-risk volatility cannot eliminate: the Western 'fear trade' driven by over $350 trillion of global debt and MMT-style fiscal policy, and the Asian and Middle Eastern 'love trade' representing approximately 60% of global gold buying, tied to portable family wealth, jewelry, and cultural saving preferences across 3 billion people in China, India, and the Gulf. Holmes explicitly links BRICS Belt and Road expansion and the growth of yuan-settlement infrastructure to structural central bank gold accumulation that is creating a floor under $4,000 — and argues that gold miners, trading at compressed multiples relative to the physical metal and generating record per-ounce margins, are the most compelling way to own gold exposure heading into what he sees as the continuation phase of the bull market.

headline: KAZATOMPROM +9%, CAMECO -5% IN H1 — Opposite Production Trends At World's Two Largest Uranium Producers; Utility Contracting Absorbs Kazakh Growth
snippet: World Nuclear News published August 3, 2026 mid-year production updates from the two largest uranium producers globally: Kazatomprom (Kazakhstan) produced 13,291 tonnes of uranium on a 100% basis in H1 2026, up 9% year-on-year, reiterating its full-year 2026 guidance of 27,500-29,000 tU while noting that H1 sales volumes 'closely aligned with the corresponding period last year'; and Cameco (Canada) produced 10.1 million pounds U3O8 (Cameco's share) in H1 2026, down 5% from H1 2025 following logistical challenges including flooding that caused a bridge collapse on primary supply routes to McArthur River and Key Lake in northern Saskatchewan in May, though both companies affirmed they remain on track for full-year 2026 production targets. The divergence — Kazakh volume growth absorbed by utility re-contracting demand while Cameco faces supply disruptions at its highest-grade assets — reinforces the structural case for sustained uranium prices above $85/lb that junior uranium developers in the Athabasca Basin and globally require to attract mine construction financing.

headline: GOLDSEEK SWOT: GOLD-TO-SILVER RATIO FLASHING BULLISH — Historical Divergence Points To Silver Catch-Up Trade As GSR Signals Precious Metals Re-Rating
snippet: GoldSeek's weekly Gold SWOT analysis published in early August 2026 identifies the gold-to-silver ratio as a developing bullish technical signal for silver — noting that silver has historically outperformed gold in the later stages of precious metals bull markets when the GSR contracts sharply, and that the current GSR level represents a setup where silver's catch-up to gold is overdue. Silver has lagged gold's recovery from the March 2026 lows, with industrial demand from solar panel and electronics manufacturing cutting back at high prices while coin and bar demand has surged 18%, creating a supply-demand structure where a catalyst (such as a September Fed pause signal or a de-escalation of Iran tensions reducing oil and inflation expectations) could trigger a rapid GSR compression. For TSX-V junior silver investors and producers with silver co-product credits, the technical setup on the gold-to-silver ratio is the most watched technical indicator in the precious metals space entering the critical NFP week.

headline: RESOLUTE MINING AT DIGGERS: Doropo Permit In Hand, 250-275k oz GUIDANCE At $2,000-2,200 AISC — West Africa Producer Lays Out Growth Case (ASX: RSG)
snippet: Resolute Mining (ASX: RSG) presented at Diggers & Dealers 2026 in Kalgoorlie on August 3-4, laying out a growth case centred on the Syama Mine in Mali and the newly permitted Doropo Gold Project in Côte d'Ivoire, where the Council of Ministers issued a 14-year mining permit in Q1 2026 — clearing the final regulatory gate for what the company targets as first gold production in H2 2028. 2026 production guidance is 250,000-275,000 ounces at all-in sustaining costs of $2,000-$2,200 per ounce, with AUD $1.1 billion in combined cash and gold inventory and a market capitalisation of approximately AUD $3.3 billion; however, management acknowledged permit delays and limited explosives access at Syama as near-term operational risks. For retail gold investors, the Resolute story at Diggers captures the defining tension of the 2026 West African gold sector: extraordinary per-ounce margins ($1,800-2,000/oz at current gold prices) that are compelling on paper, paired with the jurisdictional risk premium that keeps mid-tier African producers trading at steep discounts to their Canadian and Australian counterparts.

headline: ANALYSTS: GOLD MINERS AT 'HISTORIC DISCOUNT' TO BULLION — Sub-$2,000 AISC + $4,000 Gold = Record Margins; Institutional Underweight Sets Stage For Re-Rating
snippet: The Canadian Mining Report's August 2026 analysis argues that gold mining stocks are positioned to outperform physical gold by 2x or more in the remainder of 2026, as industry-wide all-in sustaining costs remaining below $2,000 per ounce against a $4,000+ spot price create per-ounce margins that are the highest in the modern history of the gold mining industry — yet the MarketVector Global Gold Miners Index, despite rising 21% in February 2026, still trades at a significant discount to physical gold on a price-to-cash-flow basis relative to historical precedent. The argument rests on institutional underweight: most generalist funds exited gold equities during the 2022-2023 bear market and have not re-entered at scale despite the commodity's recovery to $4,000+, creating a re-rating catalyst that historically has produced 2x+ leverage to physical gold when fund flows rotate in. For TSX-V junior investors, the context matters: the operating leverage that generates 2x returns in mid-tier producers translates into even greater leverage in exploration-stage juniors whose NPVs are directly pegged to the long-run gold price that analysts are now revising from $1,800 to $3,650.
